text: The two reply-to-self branches directly set m_identity and then their reply headers. The adjacent comment explains why they avoid the full SetIdentity path. The selected setter code also requires an editor and begins signature work, which is beyond a simple field assignment. This historical patch only fixes want in that existing comment; it introduces no new bypass or behavior. Keep this as a local caller exception with an explicit reason, not a general rule to bypass setters. No reply, signature, build or test execution was performed.
title: Reply-to-self comments explain the narrow direct identity update
